constraints.name: account_role_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((institution_id IS NOT NULL) <> (region_name IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: account_role_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((role_code)::text <> ALL (ARRAY[('MEDICAL'::character varying)::text, ('TRANSPORT'::character varying)::text])) OR (institution_id IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: blood_classification_recorded_group_code_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((recorded_group_code)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('O-'::character varying)::text, ('O+'::character varying)::text, ('A-'::character varying)::text, ('A+'::character varying)::text, ('B-'::character varying)::text, ('B+'::character varying)::text, ('AB-'::character varying)::text, ('AB+'::character varying)::text])))

constraints.name: blood_unit_current_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((current_status)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('AVAILABLE'::character varying)::text, ('QUARANTINED'::character varying)::text, ('WITHDRAWN'::character varying)::text, ('RESERVED'::character varying)::text, ('IN_TRANSIT'::character varying)::text, ('DELIVERED'::character varying)::text])))

constraints.name: institution_institution_type_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((institution_type)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('BLOOD_BANK'::character varying)::text, ('HOSPITAL'::character varying)::text, ('COORDINATION'::character varying)::text, ('TRANSPLANT_CENTER'::character varying)::text])))

constraints.name: organ_allocation_current_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((current_status)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('RESERVED'::character varying)::text, ('SCHEDULED'::character varying)::text, ('PREPARED'::character varying)::text, ('COLLECTED'::character varying)::text, ('IN_TRANSIT'::character varying)::text, ('DELIVERED'::character varying)::text, ('ACCEPTED'::character varying)::text, ('CANCELLED'::character varying)::text])))

constraints.name: organ_donor_abo_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((abo)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('O'::character varying)::text, ('A'::character varying)::text, ('B'::character varying)::text, ('AB'::character varying)::text])))

constraints.name: organ_offer_current_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((current_status)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('AVAILABLE'::character varying)::text, ('RESERVED'::character varying)::text, ('IN_TRANSIT'::character varying)::text, ('RECEIVED'::character varying)::text, ('WITHDRAWN'::character varying)::text])))

constraints.name: organ_recipient_abo_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((abo)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('O'::character varying)::text, ('A'::character varying)::text, ('B'::character varying)::text, ('AB'::character varying)::text])))

constraints.name: organ_recipient_current_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((current_status)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('ACTIVE'::character varying)::text, ('INACTIVE'::character varying)::text, ('RESERVED'::character varying)::text, ('CLOSED'::character varying)::text])))

constraints.name: api_recipients_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((kind = 'BLOOD'::text) AND (organ_type IS NULL)) OR ((kind = 'ORGAN'::text) AND (organ_type = ANY (ARRAY['KIDNEY'::text, 'LIVER'::text, 'HEART'::text])))))
